name: B10-0063/2024 (Verts/ALE) – The devastating floods in central and eastern Europe, the loss of lives and the EU’s preparedness to act on such disasters exacerbated by climate change
title: Resolution on the devastating floods in central and eastern Europe, the loss of lives and the EU’s preparedness to act on such disasters exacerbated by climate change
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is setting out its opinion and asking for action after deadly floods in Central and Eastern Europe. It wants the EU to cut emissions faster, prepare better for extreme weather, and spend more on prevention and recovery. It also asks countries to restore nature, keep new buildings off flood-prone land, and warn people earlier.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. These are requests to the EU Commission and member states.
- **Who it affects:** People and businesses in flood-hit regions, plus farmers, cities and emergency services across the EU.
- **What happens next:** The Commission and member states decide whether to act on the requests.
